h: Fidelity Bank names Stanley Amuchie as new MD/CEO from January
p: Fidelity Bank has confirmed Stanley Amuchie as its next managing director and chief executive, after CBN approval. He takes over on 1 January 2027 from Nneka Onyeali-Ikpe.
body: Fidelity Bank Plc has confirmed Stanley Chiedoziem Amuchie as its new managing director and chief executive officer, following approval from the Central Bank of Nigeria.

Amuchie, currently an executive director and the bank's chief operations and information officer, will take over on 1 January 2027. He succeeds Nneka Onyeali-Ikpe, whose term as MD/CEO ends on 31 December 2026.
The bank's chairman, Amaka Onwughalu, said the board was confident in Amuchie's ability to lead, pointing to his deep knowledge of the bank's operations and wider industry experience.
more: The CBN has approved the appointment.
